name: Methylphenidate
summary: Methylphenidate is a central nervous system stimulant that alters catecholamine signaling through dopamine and norepinephrine transporter inhibition. This profile remains research-only while indication-specific efficacy, abuse and misuse risk, cardiovascular and psychiatric safety, interaction, formulation, age-specific, and regulatory evidence is assembled and reviewed.
